A worker stands behind a clear protective screen roughly 1.5–2 m from the camera wearer, facing forward and slightly left; the screen and counter separate them by about 0.8–1 m, and the worker appears to look downward or toward the counter rather than directly at the camera. As the camera pans and advances rightward, the worker shifts from left-center to center and then left-center again, while shelves of small containers remain above and behind the worker and the right end of the wooden counter becomes more prominent; objects and people behind the camera wearer are not visible.
